title: Recover an interrupted shared Wine lease
changes: Record the user-requested recovery of the interrupted shared Wine prefix lease while preserving the old unit and its original lease metadata.
validation: A host-visible process and PID namespace audit found no matching owner or visible Wine client; four unreadable environments belonged to identified session services. The original prefix lease was moved intact with a local recovery receipt. A new managed Wine-host unit reacquired the lease, completed wineserver -w and released it: dbg20-lease-host-audit-o1l9zurc and dbg20-lease-reacquire-2sxydeqx.
limitations: The interrupted original unit remains incomplete with its unit lease and original running receipt retained. This recovery does not prove its Wine gameplay result, native Windows or physical-device behavior.
